a45.availability_vs_value: Without A45 score_metrics cannot run at all, so every score is ENABLED by A45. Only the qualification channel is VALUED by it. Section 4.7 labelling follows value dependence, not availability, which is why results are not globally re-labelled.
a45.confirmatory_status_is_a_requirement: The value here is HUMAN-READABLE ONLY. continuation_provenance.NON_CONFIRMATORY is the authority and score_metrics.REQUIRED_CONFIRMATORY_STATUS is the scorer's independent copy; this field is CHECKED against them and cannot decide the status. Before A47.12 it was read verbatim, so a record saying CONFIRMATORY produced a scored row saying CONFIRMATORY.
